name: expenses-run
description: Run one of Expense Tracker's declared operations. Destructive rows are marked in the description — confirm with the user before running one.

command.description: expenses.expense.reconcile-accept — Accept printed total (adjust tax); expenses.expense.trust-lines — Trust the lines (clear printed total); expenses.expense.toggle-reimbursable — Mark / unmark reimbursable; expenses.expense.toggle-disputed — Not my charge (toggle); expenses.expense.copy-line — Copy as a line; expenses.expense.delete — Delete expense (destructive); expenses.expense.delete-selected — Delete selected expenses (destructive); expenses.node.copy-subtotal — Copy this subtotal; expenses.add — Add expense; expenses.tab.float — Float as a window; expenses.tab.dock — Dock back into the strip; expenses.tab.close — Close tab (destructive); expenses.tab.close-others — Close other tabs; expenses.report.new — New report; expenses.report.open — Open report…; expenses.ledger.save — Save ledger…; expenses.ledger.load — Load ledger…; expenses.tabs.restore — Reopen the standard views

data.description: Context the row would have carried — the item, list or selection the command acts on.
